verdict.rationale: Letta has explicit shared memory repositories (letta-docs-8, 21, 29) giving multiple agents access to common context, plus org-level collaborator/permission controls that keep private agents/conversations private by default while allowing sharing (letta-docs-97, 98) and team agent-sharing with permissions (letta-docs-87). However, evidence doesn't show fine-grained control over which specific memory blocks are shared vs private within a single agent, nor multi-user access control specifics for shared memory repos. missing for 10: granular block-level sharing controls, documented per-user access permissions on shared memory repos, independent/hands-on verification of privacy boundaries.
